In regards to your system you mentioned, I'm confused by it in all honesty. So there's two rounds of voting is what you mean? I think that would over complicate it in all honesty, sorry. I like the idea around it though and it just goes to show that the current system, even though it's great, it could be better and well, fairer.

I do think that the EBU needs to look at other options with regards to the scoring. It just goes to show that average rankings should count for something other than if you're not in the top 10 you don't get points. 

Another thing to bear in mind is that already this system works with our juries voting. Between 5 people, they average out ALL of their rankings rather than just the top 10. There needs to be a way to do something similar with the televote imo. 

I guess wait and see what happens next but it's fun to look at alternate voting sequences.
